summary: This is an AZTI service page describing the Preference Map, a market research tool that links consumer preferences with the physico-chemical, sensory or economic characteristics of products. It is aimed at food industry marketing and R&D teams, using trained sensory expert panels and segmented consumer panels. The page lists the tool's benefits, such as identifying niche markets, predicting launch success, and guiding formulation and advertising; the rest of the page is site navigation, contact details and cookie-banner text.
one_line: AZTI's Preference Map service links food consumer preferences with product sensory, physico-chemical and economic characteristics to guide R&D and marketing.
key_facts: The Preference Map is a market research technique offered by AZTI that relates consumer preferences to product characteristics.
The tool links consumer preferences with the physico-chemical, sensory or economic characteristics of products.
AZTI describes the Preference Map as an essential approach for marketing and R&D teams to adapt products to consumer tastes and identify new market niches.
AZTI uses panels of experts trained to evaluate a wide variety of products on a sensory level.
AZTI uses panels of consumers segmented according to different profiles.
The page states that this approach works directly under the needs of companies, reducing the time it takes to obtain results.
One benefit listed is identification of new market niches by segmenting consumers into groups with similar preferences.
Another benefit is identification of the sensory attributes that have the greatest influence on consumer tastes.
The page claims improved prediction of the success of new product launches or product improvements.
The tool offers guidance on improving formulations and designing new products using sensory characterisation and consumer feedback.
A further benefit listed is optimising advertising campaigns and maximising the impact of branding.
AZTI's postal addresses include Sukarrieta (Bizkaia), Pasaia (Gipuzkoa) and Derio (Bizkaia), and its telephone number is +34 946 574 000.
The service is listed under the Consumer behaviour research area, alongside Enviroscore, consumer interaction platforms, the sensory laboratory and focus groups.
